title: [Solved] Orphan or delete multilib packages ?
body: I have several multilib / lib32-* packages in AUR but haven't used them since wow64 became the wine default . No one has commented on them since then, so it seems they're not used anymore. In theory they could still be useful for steam proton users. I'm considering to stop maintaining them but am not sure if I should file delete requests or just orphan them. What do you think ?
